method: NAIVE. Written straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate. One pass, no review.
edition_encoded: National Registration Act 1965 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/NRA1965.txt (incorporating Act 16 of 2026, in force 30 September 2026). The deposit's arrangement of sections runs one ahead of the body; the encoding follows the body.

checks.command: l4 run nra-cases-registration.l4 ; l4 run nra-cases-offences-powers.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: THE WHOLE ACT bar s 1, s 3(1)-(3) and (6)-(8) (appointments and delegation), s 4 (public servant status), s 5 (the register), s 16A (cross-border railway jurisdiction), s 20 (taking possession of false documents), ss 23, 23A and 24 (dealing with arrested persons, bail, investigation powers), ss 29 to 31 and s 33 (regulations). nra-registration.l4 carries s 2(3) and the Schedule (personal identifiers), s 3(4)-(5) (who may be a registration officer), ss 6, 7 and 9 (who must register), s 8 (names), s 10 (change of residence and the contact address), s 11 (transmission and immunity), s 12 (householders' returns), s 13 (cancellation), ss 14 and 15 (onus and proof of citizenship by birth). nra-offences-powers.l4 carries s 16 (the offences, penalties and defences), s 17 (HDB information), s 19 (attempts and preparation), s 21 (surrender of suspicious cards), s 22 (arrest and search), s 25 (notices to attend court), s 26 (officers identifying themselves), s 27 (Malaysian reports), s 28 (composition) and s 32 (service). No regulations under s 33 were retrieved; the exemptions from registration, the identity-card categories and the compoundable offences are defined there.
